meta.description: A spy party game played from your phones: everyone knows the secret place except the spy. Create a room, share the code, find the spy among you.
home.eyebrow: Party game · 3-12 players · each on their own phone
home.title: Find the spy among you.
home.lead: Everyone knows the same secret place except the spy. Ask each other questions and spot the spy from the answers, while the spy listens for a slip to guess the place.
home.create.title: Create a room
home.create.text: Choose the settings and send the code to your friends.
home.join.title: Join a room
home.join.text: Type the code your friend shared.
form.nickname.hint: 3-20 characters: lowercase letters (a-z) and digits, starting with a letter.
form.spies.hint: Lowered at the start if too few people come: 1 spy for 3-5 players, at most 2 for 6-8.
how.title: How to play
how.1.title: Create the room
how.1.text: Pick the categories, the round length and the number of spies. Share the code or the QR code.
how.2.title: Look at your card
how.2.text: Everyone sees their card on their own phone. The spy's card does not show the place.
how.3.title: Ask questions
how.3.text: Take turns asking each other about the place. Do not give too much away: the spy is listening.
how.4.title: Vote for the spy
how.4.text: When time is up, everyone votes for one player. A caught spy who names the place still wins.
join.title: Join a room
join.lead: Enter your nickname and you are in.
error.nickname_too_short: A nickname needs at least 3 characters.
error.nickname_too_long: A nickname can have at most 20 characters.
error.nickname_must_start_with_letter: A nickname must start with a letter.
error.nickname_invalid_characters: A nickname can only have lowercase letters (a-z) and digits: no accented letters, capitals or spaces.
error.nickname_in_use: Someone else is using this nickname right now.
error.nickname_taken: Someone in this room already has that name.
error.invalid_round_length: A round lasts between 1 and 15 minutes.
error.room_not_found: There is no open room with this code. Check the code.
error.room_full: The room is full (12 players at most).
error.try_again: Something went wrong, please try again.
error.404.title: Page not found
error.404.text: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
error.429.title: Slow down a little
error.429.text: Too many requests in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
error.500.title: Something went wrong
error.500.text: An unexpected error happened. Please try again shortly.
footer.note: A portfolio project. No account needed; nicknames are freed after 24 hours.
